cohort: The study included 300 intrapartum cardiotocographies (150 with and 150 without nuchal cord) randomly selected from a total cohort of 7573 births (spontaneous, vaginal-operative, secondary caesarean section) at Hanover Medical School between 2014 and 2017.
finding: CTG interpretation just before delivery is not useful to detect nuchal cord, as no specific CTG pattern could be identified and high interpretation variability existed between physicians.
cross-section timing: Intrapartum, at 60 and 30 minutes prior to delivery.
